articles.title: Maximal Aerobic Capacity and Aging in Female Masters Athletes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
articles.description: This systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrates a progressive age-related decrease in directly measured V ˙  O2max among female Masters endurance athletes. Maximal aerobic capacity declines at an average rate of 0.57 mL·kg-1·min-1...

articles.title: Sex Does Not Influence Graft Failure or Functional Recovery After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
articles.description: Sex alone does not appear to independently determine graft failure, RTS success, or functional recovery after ACL reconstruction. Instead, postoperative outcomes are more likely driven by modifiable factors such as graft characteristics...

articles.title: Sleep Strategies and Performance Outcomes in Ultramarathon Runners: A Systematic Review
articles.description: Pre-race sleep extension was associated with faster finish times, although the observational evidence does not establish causality. Further research using objective sleep measures and controlled designs is required.
